description: Signal-guided iterative grow loop. Start with tiny uniform model (Q/K=32, V=32, Out=128 per layer). Each round: train 5k steps, measure per-module grad_out_norm avg over last 1000 steps, allocate budget proportionally across 6 layers per role. Rebuild optimizer after each grow. Target budget matches exp362: Q/K total 1152 (= 192x6), V total 1536 (= 256x6 baseline, or graded), Out total 6144 (= 1024x6). 4 grow rounds (+ initial warmup) = 25k total steps. State preserved in first old_tph slots per head via grow_lut warm-start.
